description: Deskly — coworking desk booking derived from reference R11 (committed red field). Fifth family, third app category, and the second to use the committed-field archetype.

typography.displayStack: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
typography.displayRoleNote: R11 sets its headline in a warm serif over a committed red field; the role is carried, the exact face is not inferred.

responsive.mobile: Single column. Committed red hero field; desk rows below. Fixed bottom tab bar (Desks / Bookings).
responsive.desktop: Two-column desk grid. Tab bar hidden; hero field keeps its full width.
